name: Eldritch Blast
summary: Force beam(s); warlock staple attack cantrip.
description: Ranged spell attack for 1d10 force. Extra beams at 5th (2), 11th (3), 17th (4); beams can target same or different creatures.
higherLevels: Beam count scales with character level.
notes: Often paired with Agonizing Blast invocation.
